data.name: Necromantic Knowledge Gift
data.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] You can add one necromancy spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list to your spellbook, familiar, or list of spells you can prepare or to your spells known. This spell must be of a level you can cast. A spell learned in this fashion is treated as though it were on your class spell list. If you normally cast your spells from the sorcerer/wizard spells list, you can add a necromancy spell from the cleric or witch spell list instead. [Special] You can gain this manifestation multiple times. Each time you gain the gift, you gain a different necromancy spell.
